_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Further#001.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#001.dst: {u}, 좋은 소식이야. 회복될 만큼은 거의 다 회복됐어.

A Journey Further#002.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#002.dst: >그리고 영웅은 고대의 선지자를 눈멀게 하리라. 행운을 빈다.

A Journey Further#004.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#004.dst: 좋아, 가자. 가는 길에 우리 여정에 대해 더 얘기해 줄게.
A Journey Further#004.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#006.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#006.dst: 최대한 길을 따라가 보자. 네가 앞장서, 내가 따라갈게.
A Journey Further#006.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#011.dst: 잘했어. 우두머리를 죽이니 다른 놈들이 도망친 것 같아. 운이 좋았-
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#012.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#013.dst: 아, 안 돼 안 돼! 이럴 때 쓰는 물약이 있어, 어디 있지, 어디 있지, 아하! 자, 마셔!
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#014.dst: 그놈들이 네 상처를 감염시킨 게 분명해... 이 일대는 전부 위험하고 역겨워 보여.
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#015.dst: 최악을 예상해서 도움 될 만한 건 뭐든 다 챙겨 왔어. 계속 가자.
A Journey Further#015.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#016.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#016.dst: Aledar와 함께 큰길을 따라 계속 가세요.

A Journey Further#019.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#019.dst: 난... 당분간 내가 앞장설게. 적어도 잠... 깐은... 네가 또 다-다치게
A Journey Further#019.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#021.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#022.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#022.dst: {u}, 넌 그냥... 알아 둬, 네가 다치는 건 못 봐.
A Journey Further#022.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#023.dst: 이건 꼭 강조할게... 우린 반드시 함께 이 길 끝까지 가야 해.
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#026.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#026.dst: 어? 뭐... 방금 뭐... 왜 내가...
A Journey Further#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#027.dst: 괜찮아, 그냥... 왜 갑자기 이렇게 허전하지...?
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...
A Journey Further#029.dst: 알 수 없는 힘이 당신을 밀어냅니다...

A Journey Further#030.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#030.dst: 이런, 뭔가 오는 것 같아... {u}! 막아 줘, 지금은 나를 지킬 힘이 없어!
A Journey Further#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#031.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.

A Journey Further#032.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#032.dst: 후... 완전히 나아지진 않았지만... 적어도 내 몸은 지킬 수 있어.
A Journey Further#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#033.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#033.dst: 속이 텅 비어서 토할 것도 없어... 왜 아직도 이렇게 어지럽지? 물약이 도움 될지도...
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#035.dst: 우웩, 퉤! 토한 게 이것보단 맛있었겠다...
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#036.dst: 하... 바로 이거야. 근데 이게 무슨 물약이었지... ... 탈모 치료제? 이게 왜 먹혀?
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#037.dst: 그런데, 내가 친 그 야수가 어떻게 됐는지 봤어? 따라와.
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 임무 설명서에서 기억하기로, 이건 "Void Hole"이라고 불러. 일종의 포탈이야.
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#039.dst: 서로 이상하게 연결되는데, 내가 쳐서 날린 야수가 저쪽에서 나오는 걸 봤으니...
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#040.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#041.dst: 좋아, 됐다! 적어도 연결은 일정하네. 이제 네가 해 봐.
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#043.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#043.dst: Aledar와 함께 오솔길을 따라 계속 가세요.

A Journey Further#044.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#044.dst: 이 얘길 하는 건, 하나를 봤으니 곧 더 많이 보게 될 거라서야. 그 모습에 익숙해져야 할 거야.
A Journey Further#044.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#046.dst: 여기서 겪을 어려움을 너무 얕봤어. 여기서 '우리'란 나랑 Elphie, Lucio를 말하는 거야...
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#047.dst: 다들 준비도 안 됐고 자만했지. 솔직히 말해서, 네가 없었으면 난 벌써 죽었어.
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#048.dst: 처음엔 네가 함께 가는 게 확신이 안 섰는데, 이 일에 딱 맞는 사람이란 걸 충분히 증명했어.
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#049.dst: ...지도가 오래됐을 거라 짐작했어야 했는데. 이 가시 벽은 지도에 없는데, 길이 이리로 나 있어!
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#050.dst: 새로 생긴 거라고 봐야겠지... 새로 생긴 거라면 부수고 지나갈 수 있을지도.
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#051.dst: {u}, 동시에 주문을 날려 봐! 이것들을 깨부수자!
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#053.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#053.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#054.dst: 난 바보야... 그러다 죽을 뻔했어. 임무를 망칠 뻔했다고...
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#055.dst: 미안하지만, 나 없이 가야겠어. 지금은 한 발짝도 못 움직여.
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#056.dst: 이 근처엔 Void Hole이 많아, 내 경고 기억하지... 그걸로 이 가시를 넘을 수 있을 거야.
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#057.dst: 진즉 생각했으면 먼저 제안했을 텐데... 네가 넘어가면, 우리가... 어. 뭔가 해 보자.
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#058.dst: 그냥... 어디로 가는지 조심해. Void Hole은 어디로든 이어질 수 있어. 아주, 아주 위험한 곳으로 데려갈 수도 있어, 너한테도 너무 위험한 곳으로. 제발 그러지 않길...
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#059.dst: 바로 저기 시험해 볼 Void Hole이 있어. 이제 가. 이건 네가 해야 해.
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#060.dst: Void Hole을 이용해 가시 장벽 뒤로 가 보세요

A Journey Further#061.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#061.dst: Aledar가 가시 장벽 반대편으로 갈 수 있도록 도울 방법을 찾으세요.

A Journey Further#062.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#063.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#063.dst: 뭘 했는지 모르겠지만, 뭐였든 가시에 금이 가서 이쪽에서도 보여.
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#064.dst: 기운이 좀 돌아왔어... 다시 주문을 써 보자. 동시에 쓰면 뭔가 진전이 있을지도 몰라.
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 그래도 다시 가시에 머리를 박진 않을게. 약속해.
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#066.dst: 네가 먼저 해. 네 주문 소리가 들리면 바로 쓸게.
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#068.dst: 이제 가장 힘든 부분이야... 따라와. 네가 있어야 해.
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#069.dst: 저기 저 칼... 제물을 바치기 위한 거야. 저 문 닫힌 거 보이지?
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#070.dst: Outlook으로 가는 문을 열려면, 강력한 영혼을 제물로 바쳐야 해.
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#071.dst: 우린... 처음부터 말했어야 했어. 너랑 Lucio한테. Elphie랑 난 알았어. 이게 여기 있다는 걸 알았어.
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 우린... 제물로 누굴 바칠지 정하지 않았어. 여기 도착하면 정하는 게 최선이라고 결정했지. 그리고 둘 다 우리 중 하나여야 한다는 걸 알았던 것 같아.
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
A Journey Further#073.dst: ...Elphie는 자기가 하겠다고 고집했을 거야. 우리 둘 다 남겨 두고 갈 게 있었는데도...
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#074.dst: 이제 상관없어. 남은 건 우리뿐이야. 마을에 온 뒤로 계속 생각했어... 날 제물로 바쳐. 거절은 안 받아.
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#075.dst: 그러니까... 내 꼴을 좀 봐, {u}! 난 이미 죽기 직전이고, 넌 전성기의 나보다도 훨씬 강하다는 걸 증명했어.
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#076.dst: 자. 내가 가진 거 전부 가져가. 에메랄드랑 던전 열쇠. 나한텐 더 이상 쓸 일이 없을 테니까.
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#077.dst: 탑 꼭대기에는... 음, 뭔가가 있어. 정확히 뭔지는 모르지만, 네가 지나가지 못하게 막을 거야.
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#078.dst: 장벽을 부수려면 그걸 죽여야 해. 하지만... 도와줄 다른 병사들을 찾아. 혼자서는 절대 못 이겨.
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#079.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#079.dst: ...그럼 더는 미루지 말자. 피가 너무 많이 흘러.
A Journey Further#079.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#081.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.

A Journey Further#082.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#082.dst: 이제... 날 베어. 내 영혼이 문을 열 거야...
A Journey Further#082.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#085.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#085.dst: 넌... 할 수 있어. 알-알고 있어.
A Journey Further#085.speaker: Aledar
